en.name: HP 304 Ink Cartridge (Black + Tri-color)
en.shortDescription: Original HP 304 ink cartridge set for HP DeskJet and ENVY printers.
en.description:
## HP 304 Ink Cartridge

Original HP ink that protects your printer and delivers consistent print quality, compatible with HP DeskJet 2620/2630 and ENVY 5020/5030 series.

- Black and tri-color cartridge pair
- Prints up to 120 pages (black), 100 pages (color)

so.name: HP 304 Ink Cartridge (Black + Tri-color)
so.shortDescription: Xirmo khad HP 304 ah oo asal ah, loogu talagalay daabacayaasha HP DeskJet iyo ENVY.
so.description:
## HP 304 Ink Cartridge

Khad HP ah oo asal ah oo ilaalisa daabacahaaga oo bixisa daabacaad tayo leh, waxay la jaanqaadaa taxanaha HP DeskJet 2620/2630 iyo ENVY 5020/5030.

- Lamaane khad oo madow iyo midab-kaladuwan
- Waxay daabacdaa ilaa 120 bog (madow), 100 bog (midab)
